regions.today: A cold start today with widespread frost and some icy patches. Any frost and ice will gradually clear to leave a dry day with hazy sunshine. There is the chance of an isolated shower near southeast coasts later. Highest temperatures of just 7 to 9 degrees in a light variable breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight cloud will build from the south but occasional clear spells will persist. Remaining mostly dry with just isolated showers. Another cold night with lowest temperatures of -1 to +3 degrees. Frost developing for some in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be generally dry with well scattered showers. Cloudier overall, though still with some hazy sunny spells away from coasts. Feeling milder with highest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees in moderate southerly winds, fresher near southeast coasts.
